bearing.model.v1alpha1.BackupFrame.schem.description:
BackupFrame is one length-delimited message of a backup stream. A stream
 is a header, any number of records, then a trailer.

record.description: One record of the body, in a format the header names.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.BackupFrame.schem.title: Backup Frame

bearing.model.v1alpha1.BackupHeader.sche.description: BackupHeader says what a backup holds and what restoring it must give.

^(lastSubjectId)$.description: The last subject ID the store minted; empty if none.

format.description: The body's format, chosen by the store that wrote it.

head.description: The store's head when it was backed up; absent for an empty store.

last_subject_id.description: The last subject ID the store minted; empty if none.

version.description: The body format's version. A store refuses a version it doesn't know.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.BackupHeader.sche.title: Backup Header

bearing.model.v1alpha1.BackupTrailer.sch.description: BackupTrailer closes a backup stream. A stream without one is truncated.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of every byte of the stream before this frame.

bearing.model.v1alpha1.BackupTrailer.sch.title: Backup Trailer
